<b>Pendragors</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are heavy insects from [[Verdania]] that live near large bodies of water.<ref>Pendragor Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Heavy insect that lives near large bodies of water."</i></ref> Pendragors are larger variants of the [[Pendra]].

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pendragors are non-hostile flying enemies that hover over bodies of water and fly horizontally in periodic bursts. Despite their lack of hostility, they still deal {{Damage|1}} contact damage.

Often usable for platforming.

Respawns upon re-entering the room.

== Location ==
Pendragors can be found in [[Lost Verdania]].
